notes: WArmy 0.4.25 — seven-item fix round (R230): (1) the My-page Import data / Export data / Scheduled export buttons were dead because their click bindings lived in the Settings render branch while the buttons render in the My-page branch — bindings moved back to the My-page branch and the two handlers hoisted to module scope, so all three now really open their dialogs, export really writes a package, scheduled export really persists, and import really runs the validation chain; (2) the business-card button next to the profile name is removed entirely (button, dialog, styles and its 16 i18n keys); (3) the add-contact dialog's "my identity" line now follows the renamed profile username instead of the preset identity alias, and every generated join QR code (my contact QR, join-panel QR, group/project invite QR) copies the QR IMAGE to the clipboard on double-click; (4) the project/group right-click Settings info window is no longer squeezed back to 360px by the confirm-dialog CSS rule — it keeps its intended 720px width; (5) creation default names now come from localized pools: 14 Overlord goblin-army individual names for workhorses, 11 goblin corps names for projects, 12 famous anime organization names for group chats, each in all 27 locales (official EN/JA/KO/zh-TW translations where they exist, faithful local-language renderings elsewhere, with the project's local "workhorse" word as prefix), randomly picked without duplicating existing names, and frozen as literal strings at creation so switching display language later never renames them; (6) the constant faint buzz from speakers while the app was open is fixed: the audio keep-alive source looped 4 samples at -58dBFS (audible periodic buzz on quiet setups); it now loops at -100dBFS, below DAC noise floor, still keeping the output stream warm. Verified by a 31-assertion real-machine probe covering every item (real clicks, real package write, real settings persistence, real clipboard image, real width measurement, pool membership/dedup/language-freeze) plus the scoped suite: 17 gates x 3 consecutive clean rounds covering exactly the changed surfaces plus R224-R229 contract regressions.
